entities.name: R4 X_ITE LOD distance scaling defect

triples.evidence: X_ITE 16.4.3 SwiftShader: 23 frames 59-62 fps, load 12.2 s.
One Transform ZOOM: scale 600/D (361 keys, linear in log D from 600 m to 10^17.9 m)
IntegerSequencers switch 5 ground stages instead of LOD.
globe GeoElevationGrid 361x181 x20 with Blue Marble
GeoViewpoint orientation is tangent-frame, so its default looks at the horizon.
Drillfield splats: 197 Cycles views (rendered on container CPU, 7.6 min), gsplat 30k steps 709 s, 453,485 splats
lite 60,163 splats (2 per 2 m cell, 8 MB) Inlined in the 4.0 zoom via Switch DsmMode.
lite 60,163 splats (2 per 2 m cell, 8 MB) Inlined in the 4.0 zoom via Switch DsmMode.
Exported by x3d-blender-io: full 60.7 MB in 4 gzip+b64 parts (page loads via createX3DFromString, 9.4 s SwiftShader), lite 60,163 splats
gsplat 30k steps 709 s, 453,485 splats, held-out 37.43 dB / SSIM 0.986
Findings (all have repros): R1 GeoElevationGrid at 1 m loses 0.16 m RMS / 0.28 m max to float32 geocentric rounding, with visible creases
R3 spec defines 23 Earth ellipsoids only, but X_ITE ships SUN to PLUTO and its URANUS equatorial radius is 2555e3 (10x too small)
